[P2] Cover the remaining Bedrock load-recovery branch

The new recovery test exercises `sageMakerTransport` and `once()`, but Bedrock retains this separate loader. Its failure tests reset modules before each failure, so deleting `runtime = undefined` leaves their assertions unchanged while permanently caching a failed import. This remains uncovered under CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the loader/test design and either reuse the tested shared loader or require failure followed by success through the same retained `llm()` instance.
